commands:
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
test -n "$CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY" || {
  echo "::error::The protected Convex preview deploy key is not configured."
  exit 1
}
case "$CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY" in
  preview:*:*'|'*) ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::CONVEX_PREVIEW_DEPLOY_KEY must be a project Preview Deploy Key."
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
preview_name="e2e-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
npx convex deploy \
  --preview-create "$preview_name" \
  --preview-run seed:seedDisposableE2EPreview \
  --cmd-url-env-var-name VITE_CONVEX_URL \
  --cmd 'printf "%s\n" "$VITE_CONVEX_URL" > "$E2E_PREVIEW_URL_FILE"'

preview_url="$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$E2E_PREVIEW_URL_FILE")"
case "$preview_url" in
  https://*.convex.cloud) ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::Convex did not return a valid disposable preview URL."
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
printf 'url=%s\n' "$preview_url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "SPA Convex origin: $preview_url"
# Previews inherit production env, not aromatic-okapi-265. Prod currently has
# no env vars, so JWT_PRIVATE_KEY/JWKS must be copied onto the preview.
# PEM newlines cannot be argv (`unknown option -----BEGIN`); use --from-file.
# Never copy Notion aromatic-okapi-265 user passwords.
set -euo pipefail
case "$PREVIEW_URL" in
  https://*.convex.cloud) ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::Missing disposable preview URL for env set."
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
deployment="${PREVIEW_URL#https://}"
deployment="${deployment%.convex.cloud}"
echo "Preview deployment: $deployment"

if [ -z "${JWT_PRIVATE_KEY:-}" ] || [ -z "${JWKS:-}" ]; then
  echo "::error::e2e-protected secrets JWT_PRIVATE_KEY/JWKS are not set. Copy them from the aromatic Convex dashboard (not Notion test passwords)."
  exit 1
fi

jwt_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/convex-jwt.pem"
jwks_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/convex-jwks.json"
umask 077
printf '%s' "$JWT_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$jwt_file"
printf '%s' "$JWKS" > "$jwks_file"
npx convex env set JWT_PRIVATE_KEY --from-file "$jwt_file" --deployment "$deployment"
npx convex env set JWKS --from-file "$jwks_file" --deployment "$deployment"
rm -f "$jwt_file" "$jwks_file"
echo "Set JWT_PRIVATE_KEY and JWKS on $deployment (values redacted)."
npx playwright test e2e/login-smoke.e2e.ts --reporter=github,list
mkdir -p test-results
if [ -n "$TEST_FILTER" ]; then
  npx playwright test --grep "$TEST_FILTER" --reporter=github,list,json
else
  npx playwright test --reporter=github,list,json
fi
